import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionProducer
import MumfordLib.SingularSmallChains

/-!
# Preservation of small singular chains by subdivision

A natural operator on singular chains preserves the chains in each subset:
lift a simplex to that subset and apply naturality to its inclusion. In
particular barycentric subdivision preserves chains subordinate to any family
of subsets, without an openness assumption.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {m n : ℕ}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Naturality in the ambient space implies preservation of small chains,
also for operators that change degree. -/
theorem singularSimplexChain_naturalOperator_small_factor
    (T : ∀ Y : TopCat, (IntegralSingularChainComplex Y).X n ⟶
      (IntegralSingularChainComplex Y).X m)
    (hT : ∀ {Y Z : TopCat} (f : Y ⟶ Z),
      T Y ≫ (SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f m =
        (SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f n ≫ T Z)
    {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X)
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌))
    (hσ : σ ∈ (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    ∃ c : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X m,
      c ≫ (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f m = singularSimplexChain σ ≫ T X := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_iff X U _ σ).1 hσ
  have hσi := (mem_singularSubset_iff X (U i) _ σ).2 hi
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := hσi
  let f : TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (U i)) ⟶
      (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).toSSet :=
    (singularSubsetIso X (U i)).hom ≫
      SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (singularSubset_le_smallSingularSubcomplex X U i)
  have hf : f ≫ (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι =
      TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U i)) := by
    simp [f]
  have hfchain : SSet.chainComplexMap f (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) ≫
      smallSingularChainInclusion X U =
        SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U i)))
          (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) := by
    change ((SSet.chainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map f ≫
      ((SSet.chainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map _ = _
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, hf]
  refine ⟨singularSimplexChain τ ≫ T (TopCat.of (U i)) ≫
    (SSet.chainComplexMap f (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f m, ?_⟩
  have hfm := congrArg (fun g => g.f m) hfchain
  rw [HomologicalComplex.comp_f] at hfm
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hfm, hT,
    singularSimplexChain_map_assoc, hτ]

/-- Subdividing a small simplex gives a chain in the small singular complex. -/
theorem singularSimplexChain_subdivision_small_factor {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X)
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌))
    (hσ : σ ∈ (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    ∃ c : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X n,
      c ≫ (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n =
        singularSimplexChain σ ≫ singularSubdivision X n :=
  singularSimplexChain_naturalOperator_small_factor
    (fun Y => singularSubdivision Y n) (fun f => singularSubdivision_naturality f n)
    U σ hσ

end Mumford.Analytic
